name: Nebius Token Factory API
description: Connect this task to Nebius Token Factory's OpenAI-compatible inference API so it can run a small, measured real-model crossword experiment.
note: Use the Nebius Token Factory REST API for crossword candidate generation. The base URL is https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1, and the environment variable TOKEN_FACTORY_API_KEY is available. Authenticate with the HTTP Authorization header as Bearer $TOKEN_FACTORY_API_KEY. Verify access with GET https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/models. Core operations are GET /models to discover currently available models, POST /chat/completions for model inference, POST /completions for text inference, POST /embeddings for vector embeddings, and POST /rerank for relevance ranking. Example: curl 'https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/chat/completions' -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_FACTORY_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{"model":"meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say hello."}]}' . Do not assume endpoint paths or fields; check the documentation first: https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/api-reference/introduction
